Office hours

Our church is run by volunteers, so the best time to reach us is during service hours: Sunday 9:30 AM–12:00 PM, and Tuesday and Friday 7:00–9:00 PM. At other times, send a message and we’ll get back to you.

What can we help with?

Prayer requests are read by our pastor. You can also use the DCLM Prayer Request Hub.

Fields without “optional” are required.
